content.title: Little Friends Pet Sitting & Dog Walking in Charlotte, NC
content.text: Exceptional Attention to Client Service Dog Walking and Pet Sitting in Charlotte, NC Since 2010 Your Safe and Trusted Charlotte, NC Dog Walkers and Pet Sitters Our Charlotte pet sitters and dog walkers provide the friendly, compassionate care your pet family deserves. Pet Sitting The comforts of home. Our Charlotte pet sitting experts provide in-home care for your pets when it’s needed most. Choose service times right for you, from 20- to 90-minute drop-in visits to overnight or extended live-in care. Dog Walking Routines count. You can choose the service times that work best for you, and our Charlotte dog-walking experts will be ready to go. Daily, weekly, and custom schedules are welcome for your convenience. Overnight Stays A helping hand while you’re away from home. Overnight care includes a morning walk and feeding, an evening walk and feeding, and an overnight stay by your pet sitter. Plus, your pet will get a snuggle buddy! Your Reliable Charlotte Area Pet Sitting and Dog Walking Service! Sign up today to connect with experienced and dependable Charlotte pet sitters and dog walkers who provide the special care and attention your pet needs. Our Affiliates and Awards! HOW IT WORKS Little Friends is locally operated and empowered by Swifto Scheduling pet care with Swifto is easy! We're passionate about providing kind, safe, reliable care for your pet. Plus, you get online access to your pet while you're away, and set up is simple. Register online and create your client profile on Swifto. Submit your service request online on Swifto. Meet your pet sitter or dog walker in person. Receive pet care report cards with GPS tracking, photos, and visit notes. Because you should never settle for less! Why Choose Little Friends Pet Sitting & Dog Walking? User-Friendly Platform Schedule pet care online through Swifto. Convenient Mobile App Book pet care on the go from anywhere are anytime. 5 Star Staff Our team is insured, bonded and background checked. Customizable Pet Care You design your pet's care plan! We follow it. In-Person Meeting Complementary consultation with your pet's caregiver. Streamlined Communications You will receive your dog walker or pet sitter's number so you can text or call them directly. Ongoing Support Real-time support from 9am to 5pm daily. Open 365 Days a Year Providing service 365 days a year, including all holidays. Detailed Care Reports Report cards sent after each visit with photos and GPS tracking. Every provider has been communicative and truly cared for and loved on my senior kitty. Most recently Erin took care of my cat Hercules. Her daily messages provided me with pictures and a detailed message about her visit. I never had any doubt he was being well cared for. Highly recommend!" Suzanne W. "We hired Little Friends Pet Sitting & Dog Walking for a long weekend getaway for a family wedding. The service was fantastic. Our dogs loved her immediately (we have 3). She showed up on time, sent lots of photo visits, communicated regularly and were so nice and professional." I really enjoyed myself without having to be stressed out! It was so wonderful. I will definitely be using them again!"
